speaker: Unknown

en: I think we were very prepared when our time came.

en: The mechanics of how Cauchy operates in a sportsbook is completely different, right?

speaker: Unknown
en: And that's why they are regulated different ways.
zh: 这就是为什么它们以不同的方式被监管。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's why we are federally regulated, right?
zh: 这就是为什么我们是受联邦监管的,对吧?

speaker: Unknown
en: We are an exchange, which means that you trade against someone else.
zh: 我们是一个交易所,这意味着你是和其他人交易。

speaker: Unknown
en: We don't set the price.

speaker: Unknown
en: We don't set the odds.

speaker: Unknown
en: We don't trade against the users.
zh: 我们不和用户对赌。

en: The users are just trading against each other and we take a transaction fee.

en: What matters the most here is liquidity and making sure that we have national liquidity to build upon.

en: Imagine if you have, for example, the New York Stock Exchange, but you could only buy stocks in the New York Stock Exchange if you're in New York.

en: The prices would be significantly worse.

speaker: Unknown
en: It would not be a liquid market.
zh: 它不会是一个流动的市场。

speaker: Unknown
en: It would just be worse for every participant.

speaker: Unknown
en: And also, the market just wouldn't work well.
zh: 而且市场本身也运转不好。

speaker: Unknown
en: On the sportsbook, on the other hand, it operates completely different, right?
zh: 另一方面,sportsbook 的运作方式完全不同,对吧?

speaker: Unknown
en: Like, for example, in the exchange...
zh: 比如,在交易所里……

speaker: Unknown
en: Because we also don't treat against our users, we don't make money when users lose.
zh: 因为我们不与用户对赌,用户亏钱时我们不赚钱。

speaker: Unknown
en: A sportsbook is actually completely different.
zh: sportsbook 则完全不同。

speaker: Unknown
en: They make money, their revenue is equal to customer losses.
zh: 他们赚钱,他们的收入等于客户的损失。

speaker: Unknown
en: The more the customers lose, the more money they make.
zh: 客户亏得越多,他们赚得越多。

speaker: Unknown
en: For us, it's not the same.
zh: 对我们来说不是这样。

speaker: Unknown
en: The incentive is not to make people lose because we don't make money when people lose.
zh: 我们的动机不是让人亏钱,因为人们亏钱时我们不赚钱。

speaker: Unknown
en: Because of that as well, we don't cap our winners.
zh: 正因如此,我们不限制赢家。

speaker: Unknown
en: So, you know, if you go to a sportsbook or casino, you start making money, they'll make sure that you cannot participate anymore.
zh: 你知道的,如果你去 sportsbook 或赌场,你开始赚钱了,他们会确保你不能再参与。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's the opposite.
zh: 我们正好相反。

speaker: Unknown
en: We want winners.
zh: 我们想要赢家。

speaker: Unknown
en: We want people to come and bring price and we want price competition.
zh: 我们想要人们带着价格来,我们想要价格竞争。

speaker: Unknown
en: And all of those kind of like, really, there's no like price competition, right?
zh: 而那些那种……真的,那里没有价格竞争,对吧?

speaker: Unknown
en: The sportsbook has a monopoly on the price and they're going to put their margins on top because like they're having a bad month.

speaker: Unknown
en: So they're going to make the prices a little worse or whatever.
zh: 所以他们会把价格弄差一点之类的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And because of that, it's like it, they are very fundamentally different mechanics and very fundamentally different products and they need to be regulated in different ways, which is how the federal regulation for exchanges develop a certain way.

speaker: Unknown
en: And, you know, we're growing a lot because, you know, an exchange is a fair...

speaker: Unknown
en: A fair, more accessible, more transparent way to trade.

en: You can see all the prices.

speaker: Unknown
en: You can see the competition and the order book in real time.

speaker: Unknown
en: And that's why users like it so much.

speaker: Unknown
en: And I think it's fair and it should be that the consumers at the end of the day pick what's better for them.

en: Something like 75% of the volume of your business is sports.

en: Well, the thing is speculation happens in all financial markets.

speaker: Unknown
en: You know, crypto, stocks, options, futures, there's speculation in all of them.

en: And speculation is actually very important because it drives liquidity, right?
